items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul Robeson, you’d hear him on a record or something, it meant something.

ctx.x: What was your impression of that music?

Wait a minute. This man is telling a story and singing it. The way he sang was very expressive. I said, uh-uh. I got – that’s the way I got to sing. It’s got to mean something. If you listen to him, it meant something, and you knew it meant something. Paul Robeson, you’d hear him on a record or something, it meant something.
So it was the dramatic way that he told the story in song.
